comparison.objective: Select fitting tweezers and peel protective film from a display module while stabilizing its carrier; candidate screens finishing media from washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool selection by tip fit, tab capture, controlled adhesive peeling, carrier stabilization, and tool replacement versus bimanual pouring and screen agitation.
comparison.success_condition: Grades peeled length to 115 mm, limits carrier motion and premature seam separation, requires film deposited outside the carrier, both tweezers returned, and hands clear for 1 s. Candidate grades mass transfer/recovery, washer retention, spill/contamination/damage, and supported release. No material rubric detail is missing in the recovered board specification.
comparison.reason: Adhesive peeling with constrained tool selection tests a different ability from aperture-mediated granular sorting.
